theater: 佩滕貝邦山區多斯皮拉斯城址

battle.name: 第十一次「星際大戰」
battle.theater: 佩滕貝邦山區多斯皮拉斯城址
battle.brief: 公元711年1月3日，蒂卡爾新王基尼奇·雅什·庫克·莫自東方回國即位，隨即率聯軍攻入佩滕貝邦山區的多斯皮拉斯，擒其君主努恩·烏卓爾·查克，銘文記為第十一次「星際大戰」。卡面的羅馬弩砲靠扭力簧束發射單支鐵矢，進不了雨林；位置上相應的，是瑪雅人用擲矛器、投石索與弓箭把攻方壓在坡下。

kit.name: 羅馬弩砲
kit.history: 扭力弩砲，一發一具箭。羅馬用它拆掉希臘的城牆，也拆掉了希臘的城邦體系。

countries: 這場戰爭爆發於公元711年，交戰方是佩滕低地的兩組城邦聯盟。勝方是蒂卡爾（Tikal）及其東佩滕的附屬城邦聯軍：蒂卡爾在705年5月被多斯皮拉斯攻破之後，王統中斷近半個世紀，711年新王基尼奇·雅什·庫克·莫自東方回國即位，隨即重整王統與祭司集團，把城邦內的村社徵召與神將團（K'uhul，文獻譯作「神將」）編為出征主力，由王室直接統轄，後方靠蒂卡爾周邊的玉米田與聖巴托洛河的水路維持糧秣。敗方是佩滕貝邦王國的核心多斯皮拉斯（Dos Pilas），其君主努恩·烏卓爾·查克自705年起執政，此時正倚仗宗主卡拉科爾的聲援與佩滕北部的高地；軍隊同樣以神將團為骨幹，配備精銳投射兵與村社民兵，城防倚仗石灰岩台地的陡坡、外圍哨站與蓄水池。第三方是卡拉科爾（Caracol）——多斯皮拉斯的宗主，711年保持觀望；佩滕的塞伊瓦爾、烏克斯特佩通與帕倫基等城邦在兩強之間搖擺，未介入本役。城邦之間沒有常設的指揮系統，聯軍靠盟誓、婚盟與共享的祭祀曆法維繫，臨陣由國王與祭司共同定奪出征的時機與方位。
countriesEn: This war broke out in AD 711 between two blocs of city-states in the Petén lowlands. The winning side was Tikal together with a coalition of the subordinate towns of eastern Petén: after Tikal had been overrun by Dos Pilas in May 705, its dynasty had been interrupted for nearly half a century, and in 711 the new ruler K'inich Yax K'uk' Mo' returned from the east, took the throne, rebuilt the royal house and the priestly order, and organized the village levies together with the sacred warrior corps (K'uhul, rendered in the literature as the 'god warriors') into a field army under the king's own command, with the maize fields around Tikal and the water route of the San Bartolo river behind it to feed the column. The defeated side was the core of the Petexbatún polity, Dos Pilas, whose ruler Nuun Ujool Chaak had governed since 705 and who now leaned on the support of his overlord Caracol and on the heights of northern Petén; his army rested on the same sacred warrior corps, with elite missile troops and village levies, and the defence of the city relied on the steep limestone terraces of the site, its outlying watch-posts and its reservoirs. Third parties were Caracol, Dos Pilas's overlord, which watched the fight in 711 without joining it, and Petén cities such as Seibal, Uxactun and Palenque, which swung between the two sides and stayed out of the campaign. There was no permanent command structure between the cities: the coalition rested on alliance oaths, marriage ties and a shared ritual calendar, and in the field the timing and direction of the campaign were decided jointly by the ruler and his priests.
people: 蒂卡爾方面的關鍵人物是基尼奇·雅什·庫克·莫（K'inich Yax K'uk' Mo'）：他在705年蒂卡爾陷落之後流亡東方，711年率追隨者回國即位，其即位與討伐的紀錄集中見於717年豎立的蒂卡爾十六號碑，碑上把他記為重整蒂卡爾王統、並在佩滕貝邦擒獲敵國君主的人。蒂卡爾此前的兩位君主——賈索·錢·卡維爾一世（Jasaw Chan K'awil I）與伊察克·巴蘭（Yich'aak B'alam）——也留在碑刻與著錄裡；705年那一役之後，蒂卡爾在約半個世紀裡沒有豎立新碑。多斯皮拉斯方面的君主是努恩·烏卓爾·查克（Nuun Ujool Chaak），他在670年代奪取該城統治權，705年率軍攻破蒂卡爾、擒其君主，卻在711年被蒂卡爾反攻擒獲，此後從銘文中完全消失；到735年，多斯皮拉斯的王座已由葉什·努恩·阿欣一世（Yax Nuun Ahiin I）一系主持。學術史方面，銘文學家琳達·謝萊（Linda Schele）以瑪雅文字中「星宿覆地」一類字形提出「星際大戰」的名稱；迪安與阿爾倫·蔡斯（Diane and Arlen Chase）在卡拉科爾主持的發掘，把碑銘與地層、陵墓相互對讀，使這一類衝突被確認為史事而非神話；湯姆森以及馬丁與格里芬的編年工作，則把散見的戰記整理成可核對的序列。
peopleEn: The key figure on the Tikal side was K'inich Yax K'uk' Mo': after the fall of Tikal in 705 he had gone into exile in the east, and in 711 he returned with his followers and took the throne. His accession and his campaign are recorded above all on Tikal Stela 16, erected in 717, which presents him as the man who restored the ruling line of Tikal and took an enemy ruler prisoner in the Petexbatún. The two rulers before him, Jasaw Chan K'awil I and Yich'aak B'alam, also survive in the monuments and in the catalogues; after the war of 705 Tikal raised no new stela for about half a century. The ruler of Dos Pilas was Nuun Ujool Chaak, who had seized the government of the city in the 670s and in 705 led the army that broke Tikal and took its ruler prisoner; in 711 he was in turn taken prisoner by Tikal's counter-attack and then vanishes completely from the inscriptions. By 735 the throne of Dos Pilas was in the hands of the line of Yax Nuun Ahiin I. In the history of scholarship, the epigrapher Linda Schele proposed the term 'star war' from Maya glyphs of a celestial body spread over the earth; the excavations directed by Diane and Arlen Chase at Caracol read the inscriptions against the stratigraphy and the burials, and so established that this class of conflict was history rather than myth; the chronologies of Thompson and of Martin and Grube then gathered the scattered war accounts into a sequence that can be checked.
kits: 任務單上的兵器是羅馬弩砲（Scorpio）：公元前一世紀中葉出現的扭力式單發弩砲，以搓成束的獸筋與馬鬃蓄能，鐵矢約一公尺長、前端裝鉛鏃，一發一矢，架在三腳架上，兩三人即可抬行，射程在數百步之間；維特魯維奧在《建築十書》第十卷記述的 cheiroballistra 與 paratenon，正是同一技術族最早的文字記錄。到了711年，羅馬的攻城砲早已換成皮筋投石車與拉索式投石車，弩砲退為守備與野戰的輔助兵器，並隨羅馬的邊界一同退向歐洲與北非。功能上真正可以與它對位的，是瑪雅人手中的擲矛器、投石索與弓箭：同樣是單發、必須瞄準的投射兵器，但發力全靠人的臂力，並沒有扭力簧束。差異還在物流：羅馬弩砲雖可人力抬行，仍是一具需要專人操作的機械，而瑪雅沒有馱獸、沒有車，箭矢、標槍與黑曜石刃全靠人背，任何依賴牲畜或車隊的攻城器械都無法進入佩滕的山徑。除投射兵器外，兩軍還有鑲嵌黑曜石刃的棍劍（macuahuitl，通稱馬卡納）、長矛、圓盾與獸皮覆盾、棉絮製的軟甲（ik'）；攻城一方只有繩梯、木斧、火把與挖掘用的鍬，靠人貼著岩壁攀爬。羅馬弩砲名下的「蠍子」徽記，與佩滕的瑪雅人並無任何瓜葛。
kitsEn: The weapon on the card is the Roman scorpio: a single-shot torsion ballista that appears in the middle of the first century BC, storing its energy in bundles of sinew and horsehair twisted together, firing an iron bolt about a metre long with a lead head, one bolt at a time, carried on a tripod that two or three men could lift and move, and reaching a range of a few hundred paces. The cheiroballistra and the paratenon described by Vitruvius in the tenth book of De architectura are the earliest written records of the same family of technology. By 711 the Roman siege artillery had long since given way to the onager and to traction trebuchets, and the scorpio had sunk to a supporting piece for garrison and field work, retreating with the Roman frontier into Europe and North Africa. What can really be set against it functionally is the atlatl, the sling and the bow in Maya hands: like the scorpio these are single-shot weapons that demand aim, but they draw their power from the arm alone and have no torsion bundle at all. The difference lies as much in logistics: the scorpio, though it could be carried by men, was still a machine needing a trained crew, whereas the Maya had no beasts of burden and no carts — arrows, darts and obsidian blades all went on human backs, so no siege engine that depended on animals or wagon trains could ever enter the trails of the Petén. Besides missile weapons, both armies carried the obsidian-bladed club-sword (macuahuitl, better known as the macana), long spears, round and hide-covered shields, and quilted soft armour of cotton (ik'). The besieging side had nothing but rope ladders, wooden axes, torches and digging picks, and it was men who climbed the rock face. The 'scorpion' badge of the Roman piece had nothing to do with the Maya of Petén.
tactics: 「星際大戰」在銘文學上的定義不是兩軍對撞的會戰，而是一場以摧毀對方祭祀中心、擒獲其君主為目的的決定性襲擊。蒂卡爾方面的做法是：先走水路——獨木舟隊沿聖巴托洛河與支流，把兵員、箭矢、糧秣與黑曜石刃運到多斯皮拉斯下游，再轉入陸路走佩滕貝邦的山徑；趁旱季出動，711年1月正當雨林小徑乾爽可通、田間已收而敵軍缺糧的時節；以附屬城邦的聯軍切斷多斯皮拉斯的外圍哨站與南北通道，使守軍不能互相支援；再集中主力攀上石灰岩台地。多斯皮拉斯踞高處、坡陡，進攻方沒有大型攻城器械可用，只能靠繩梯與木斧攻門、以縱火燒毀柵欄，並用鍬挖掘牆基；但更有效的辦法是切斷水源與農田——控制城外的蓄水池與周邊玉米田，守軍的糧水會自行見底。破城之後，蒂卡爾並不長駐，而是帶走君主與祭器，把王座交給受制於蒂卡爾的傀儡，這正是星際大戰的慣例。
tacticsEn: In epigraphic terms a 'star war' is not a set-piece collision between two armies but a decisive raid aimed at destroying the opposing ceremonial centre and taking its ruler prisoner. Tikal's method proceeded by water first: canoe fleets carried men, arrows, grain and obsidian blades down the San Bartolo river and its tributaries to below Dos Pilas, and the column then turned inland onto the trails of the Petexbatún. It struck in the dry season, for January 711 was a time when the forest tracks were dry and passable, the fields had been harvested and the enemy was short of food. The allied towns of eastern Petén cut the outlying watch-posts of Dos Pilas and the roads running north and south, so that the defenders could not support one another, and the main body then climbed the limestone terraces. Dos Pilas stood high and steep, and the attackers had no heavy siege engines: they could only work rope ladders and wooden axes at the gates, burn the barricades, and pick away at the footings of the walls with mattocks. Far more effective was the cutting of water and farmland — hold the reservoirs outside the city and the maize plots around it, and the defenders' food and water would run out on their own. Once the city fell, Tikal did not occupy it. It took the ruler and the cult objects away and handed the throne to a puppet answerable to Tikal, which was the custom of the star wars.
data: 可核對的硬數字有幾組。日期：公元711年1月3日，瑪雅長曆記作9.13.19.1.12，即第九巴克頓、第十三卡特恩、第十九圖恩、第一烏伊納爾、第十二金；這是與王統更替、討伐多斯皮拉斯相繫的記載日期，也是碑銘可考的第十一次「星際大戰」。碑銘：立於717年的蒂卡爾十六號碑是本役最重要的同時代旁證，碑面所記是新王的即位與對多斯皮拉斯的擒獲，而不是戰損。地理：多斯皮拉斯在佩滕貝邦山區，核心台地高出周邊平地數十至上百公尺，與蒂卡爾的直線距離約一百四十公里，步行須繞過雨林小徑與季節性溪流，糧秣全靠人背與獨木舟，行程以旬計。數量：雙方碑銘都不列戰損，只記勝負、日期與慶典；史家統計，碑銘可考的星際大戰至少十三次，時間自562年延續到781年，其中約七成對應金星的可見相位。器械：羅馬弩砲一類的扭力投射機射程在數百步，須專人操作、射速極緩，與之相比，瑪雅的擲矛器、投石索與弓箭同樣是單發瞄準，卻不必照料任何器械，射速反而快得多。
dataEn: There are several sets of figures that can be checked. First, the date: 3 January AD 711, recorded in the Maya Long Count as 9.13.19.1.12 — the ninth baktun, thirteenth katun, nineteenth t'un, first uinal and twelfth kin. This is the date tied to the change of ruler and to the campaign against Dos Pilas, and it is the eleventh star war known from inscriptions. Second, the monuments: Tikal Stela 16, erected in 717, is the most important contemporary parallel for this war, and what it records is the accession of the new ruler and the capture of Dos Pilas rather than any tally of losses. Third, geography: Dos Pilas stands in the hills of the Petexbatún, its core terraces rising several tens to over a hundred metres above the surrounding plain, and the straight-line distance to Tikal is about one hundred and forty kilometres; on foot the route has to skirt rainforest trails and seasonal streams, with all grain carried on human backs and in canoes, so that a column took weeks to move. Fourth, numbers: neither side's monuments list losses, recording only the outcome, the date and the ceremonies; counting the attested cases, at least thirteen star wars are known from inscriptions, running from 562 to 781, and about seventy per cent of them fall on a visible phase of Venus. Fifth, equipment: Roman torsion engines of the scorpio class reached a few hundred paces, needed a trained crew and fired very slowly, whereas the Maya atlatl, sling and bow were equally single-shot and aimed, yet required no machinery to be serviced and were correspondingly faster.
cause: 衝突的根子埋在705年。佩滕貝邦的多斯皮拉斯在670年代崛起，趁蒂卡爾王位更替的脆弱期於705年5月攻破蒂卡爾、擒其君主、焚其廟碑，古典期佩滕最大城邦的政權中斷了將近半個世紀。蒂卡爾王統並未斷絕：若干王族成員流亡東方，基尼奇·雅什·庫克·莫於711年率其返回，重新立起石碑、恢復祭祀，並按星際大戰的規矩以金星曆選定出兵的時機與方位。進攻多斯皮拉斯的理由是多重的：為705年之恥雪恨；趁多斯皮拉斯連年征伐、樹敵於佩滕南北而外圍盟友最孤立；更要緊的是，多斯皮拉斯的強盛正壓在蒂卡爾東進的通道上，蒂卡爾若不先拔掉這個據點，就無法恢復佩滕的霸權。盟邦關係也推了一把：多斯皮拉斯是卡拉科爾用來牽制蒂卡爾的「女兒城」，而七世紀末的佩滕，已沒有任何一方能在不動用全城兵力的前提下承受一次失敗。於是雙方都明白，這一仗不能只求驅逐，必須一舉擒住對方的君主。
causeEn: The roots of the conflict lay in 705. Dos Pilas of the Petexbatún had risen in the 670s and, taking advantage of the vulnerability that followed a change of ruler at Tikal, broke into Tikal in May 705, took its ruler prisoner and burned its stelae; the government of the largest city-state of the Classic Petén was interrupted for close to half a century. The Tikal dynasty was not extinguished: several members of the royal house went into exile in the east, and in 711 K'inich Yax K'uk' Mo' returned with them, raised stelae again, restored the cult, and, as the custom of the star wars required, chose the moment and the bearing of the campaign from the Venus tables. There were several reasons for Tikal to march on Dos Pilas: to wipe out the humiliation of 705; to catch the city while it was worn down by its own campaigns and isolated among its neighbours to the north and south; and above all because Dos Pilas's strength sat squarely across the corridor by which Tikal marched east, so that until that outpost was removed Tikal could not recover its hegemony in the Petén. The alliance system pushed in the same direction: Dos Pilas was Caracol's 'daughter city', planted to hold Tikal in check, and by the end of the seventh century no side in the Petén could afford a defeat that committed the whole city's fighting strength. Both sides therefore understood that this war could not end in a mere expulsion: the opposing ruler had to be taken.
impact: 711年的結局改變了佩滕北部的權力次序。多斯皮拉斯失去君主與正統，蒂卡爾則把這次勝利寫進王統的合法敘事；藉此重建的都城與重豎的碑刻，使它在約二十年後仍能站上佩滕的舞台。但這是一場以復國為目標的戰役，而不是霸權的確立：多斯皮拉斯的盟邦網絡仍在，蒂卡爾的東翼新附庸尚未鞏固，隨後二十多年佩滕仍在反覆的星際大戰中重新洗牌——多斯皮拉斯在735年攻破塞伊瓦爾，卻又在七三〇年代末至七四〇年代初被卡拉科爾與蒂卡爾聯手拉下來；蒂卡爾本身亦在查克·托克·伊查克一世被擒後再度陷落。多斯皮拉斯此後的歷史只剩收縮，到七六〇年代，佩滕貝邦山區的這座城被永久放棄，廢墟留在雨林裡。此役在學術上的意義也不小：星際大戰這一類別，正是靠蒂卡爾十六號碑、三十一號碑與卡拉科爾九號碑這一路銘文被逐條對讀出來的；它所確立的模式——擒王、焚廟、易姓——此後成為理解古典期城邦政治的標準框架。
impactEn: The outcome of 711 rearranged the order of power in northern Petén. Dos Pilas lost its ruler and its legitimacy, while Tikal wrote the victory into the lawful narrative of its dynasty; the rebuilt capital and the stelae raised again on that basis allowed it to remain on the stage of the Petén some twenty years later. But this was a war fought to regain a lost city, not to establish a hegemony: the network of Dos Pilas's allies survived, the new eastern dependencies of Tikal were not yet secure, and the Petén went on reshuffling itself through repeated star wars for more than two decades — Dos Pilas broke Seibal in 735, and was then pulled down again in the late 730s and early 740s by Caracol and Tikal acting together, while Tikal itself fell a second time when Chak Tok Ich'aak I was taken prisoner. What followed for Dos Pilas was only contraction, and by the 760s the city in the hills of the Petexbatún was abandoned for good, its ruins left in the rainforest. The scholarly significance of the war is also considerable: the category of the star war was read out of monuments such as Tikal Stela 16, Tikal Stela 31 and Caracol Stela 9, and the pattern it establishes — the taking of a ruler, the burning of temples, the change of dynasty — became the standard framework for understanding politics among the city-states of the Classic period.
result: 結果是直接而殘酷的：公元711年1月3日（長曆9.13.19.1.12），蒂卡爾方面的聯軍攻入多斯皮拉斯，擒獲其君主努恩·烏卓爾·查克，這一役被記為第十一次「星際大戰」。被擒者此後從銘文中完全消失，沒有留下可核對的歲數、官職或下落；多斯皮拉斯的王座轉由受蒂卡爾節制的王族主持，城本身未被徹底毀滅，卻淪為佩滕北部的附庸，直到約七六〇年代被永久放棄。雙方的死傷數目沒有可信記載，碑銘只記日期、勝負與慶典，不列戰俘與屍數；可以確定的後果有兩條：蒂卡爾藉此重新站穩了佩滕最大城邦的地位，多斯皮拉斯則失去了它作為佩滕貝邦中心的地位。放進更長的序列看，這一場是第十二次「星際大戰」的前奏：贏家在二十四年後仍佔著上風，卻沒有多斯皮拉斯當年那樣的聲勢，隨即在接下來的二十年裡被一一收回。
resultEn: The outcome was direct and brutal: on 3 January AD 711, recorded as 9.13.19.1.12 in the Long Count, the allied army of Tikal entered Dos Pilas and took its ruler Nuun Ujool Chaak prisoner; the war was recorded as the eleventh star war. The captive then disappears completely from the inscriptions, leaving no verifiable age, office or fate behind him; the throne of Dos Pilas passed to a royal line held in leash by Tikal, and the city itself was not utterly destroyed but sank into the condition of a dependency of northern Petén, until it was abandoned for good around the 760s. There is no trustworthy record of the losses on either side: the monuments give the date, the outcome and the ceremonies, and list neither prisoners nor bodies. Two consequences can be stated with confidence: Tikal recovered the standing of the largest city-state of the Petén, and Dos Pilas lost its position as the centre of the Petexbatún. Placed in the longer sequence, this war is the prelude to the twelfth star war: the victor still held the upper hand twenty-four years later, but without the momentum Dos Pilas had enjoyed, and the ground won was given back one piece at a time over the twenty years that followed.
